steps.what: The borrower approves a 0.0155 BTC top up so the moved loan fits Keel's limit
One transaction: Keel pays off the borrower's Mezo loan (0.036 BTC, 1,803 MUSD) with savers' MUSD, Mezo sends its BTC to Keel, and the same debt opens as Keel loan #2, outside redemptions

setup.what: Deploys the new KeelMarket that can take over a Mezo loan and swap BTC rewards to MUSD
Wires it to the same vault and strategy, so savers stay put
A second test wallet opens a Mezo loan to mint MUSD for savers
That MUSD is deposited as savings, so a 1,800 MUSD minimum Mezo loan fits
A test wallet opens a second Mezo loan to mint more MUSD for savers
2,110 MUSD more saved: Keel lends a smaller share and its rate falls to about 5.5%
